text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finishing training for the day…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your guidance today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Oh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow Satono Diamond's gaze to find Kitasan Black training hard.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Almost there! Just one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Um, Trainer. Actually, would you mind if I did some additional exercise today?
choice_data_list: You shouldn't push yourself too hard…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's just… I saw a video of Kita racing the other day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: She's improved quite a bit. She's gotten much faster…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It made me a bit nervous. But more than that… it made me want to run so badly!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's like she's lit a fire under me! So… please say yes!
choice_data_list: If that's how you feel, then, go for it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Okay, I'm going to run some more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to let you beat me, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with thoughts of her rival driving her forward, Satono Diamond executes a brilliant solo training session.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow? Um… I really don't think I can wait that long!
choice_data_list: Bottle up those feelings and let them explode.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …I understand. But promise me I can train to my heart's content tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …In that case! Let's watch that video of her in your office for today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That way, I'm sure I'll get even more excited and I can work even harder tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we study Kitasan Black's race intently while Satono Diamond provides a passionate commentary.
